obligations.description: Define the real forward difference by forwardDifference f x h = (f (x + h) - f x) / h. State the theorem for arbitrary f D : ℝ → ℝ and x h L : ℝ, concluding |forwardDifference f x h - D x| ≤ L * h.

Retain precisely h > 0, 0 ≤ L, ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc x (x + h)), ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo x (x + h), HasDerivAt f (D t) t, and ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo x (x + h), |D t - D x| ≤ L * |t - x|. D x is an independent reference value; require neither endpoint differentiability nor continuity of D.

Construct an interior witness c ∈ Set.Ioo x (x + h) with D c = (f (x + h) - f x) / h by applying Mathlib exists_hasDerivAt_eq_slope to f and D with endpoints x and x + h. Establish endpoint order from h > 0 and normalize (x + h) - x to h. This witness identifies the forward difference with a derivative value to which the assumed variation estimate applies.
Use the two strict interval inequalities for c to establish 0 ≤ c - x and c - x ≤ h, hence |c - x| ≤ h. Multiply this estimate by L using 0 ≤ L.
Specialize the local variation assumption at c, combine it with L * |c - x| ≤ L * h, and transport the resulting estimate through the witness equality and the forward-difference definition.

The formalizer must supply all definitions and proofs without sorry, placeholders, or custom axioms and check the resulting Lean file using local Lean and Mathlib. Preserve the original quantifiers, domain restrictions, and error constant.
